audience.text: Go developers building applications that need to generate, read, or modify Excel workbooks without external native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Read and write cell values using A1-style references with Cells.Get and Cells.Set, supporting string, float64, int, and bool types.
capabilities.title: Cell data read and write

capabilities.text: Store formulas with Cell.SetFormula and evaluate them using CalculateFormula, supporting SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN over ranges.
capabilities.title: Formula evaluation

capabilities.text: Apply visual formatting via Style objects that combine font, fill, alignment, and border settings to individual cells.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Attach DataValidation rules to worksheets to restrict cell input to dropdown lists or numeric ranges with custom error messages.
capabilities.title: Data validation

capabilities.text: Create Excel tables with AddTable, specifying range, header row presence, and built-in style names.
capabilities.title: Structured tables

capabilities.text: Import CSV files with Workbook.ImportFromCSV and export sheets to CSV using Workbook.ExportToCSV or Worksheet.ToCSV.
capabilities.title: CSV import and export

capabilities.text: Process large Excel files row-by-row using StreamingReader to minimize memory usage without loading the full workbook model.
capabilities.title: Streaming large files

capabilities.text: Protect workbooks with ECMA-376 Agile Encryption using Workbook.SetPassword and verify passwords with Workbook.VerifyPassword.
capabilities.title: Password-based encryption

limitations.text: Cell references are A1-style strings only; tuple/array indices are not supported.
CalculateFormula supports only SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN; other formulas return an error.
CSV import stores all fields as Go strings and does not infer numeric or boolean types.
Round-trip fidelity depends on reusing original XML for unmodified content and regenerating only modified parts.
Generated XML follows ECMA-376 element ordering and is not independently configurable.
The library does not support tuple/array-based cell indexing (e.g. [0,0]); only A1-style string references are supported.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel file creation and editing in Go without requiring Microsoft Office or native binaries.
Supports low-memory processing of large Excel files via streaming row access.
Provides built-in formula evaluation for common functions like SUM and AVERAGE without external engines.
Allows password-based workbook encryption using ECMA-376 Agile Encryption.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Go is a pure-Go library for creating, reading, and writing Excel workbooks (.xlsx) with no third-party dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported formula functions beyond SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN is not fully enumerated in the fact dossier.
Whether picture embedding supports formats other than PNG and JPEG is not explicitly stated.
The behavior of CalculateFormula when encountering circular references is not documented in the facts.
The maximum file size or row count that StreamingReader can handle is not specified.
Whether password-protected workbooks can be opened by third-party tools is not confirmed.
The exact version of ECMA-376 standard implemented is not specified beyond Agile Encryption details.
Whether conditional formatting rules can be applied via the public API is not fully detailed beyond the presence of ConditionalFormatting types.
The scope of VBA project support beyond setting/clearing data is not elaborated in the facts.

workflows.name: Create and save a workbook
workflows.text: Create a new workbook with NewWorkbook, write values to cells via Cells.Set, and save to .xlsx using Workbook.Save.

workflows.name: Load, edit, and save
workflows.text: Load an existing workbook with LoadWorkbook, read or update cell values using Cells.Get and Cells.Set, then save changes.

workflows.name: Process large files with streaming
workflows.text: Use NewStreamingReader to iterate over rows in a large file without loading the entire workbook into memory.

workflows.name: Apply styling to cells
workflows.text: Create Style objects with font, fill, alignment, and border settings, then apply them to cells via Cell.SetStyle.

workflows.name: Import data from CSV
workflows.text: Import a CSV file into a new workbook using Workbook.ImportFromCSV, specifying a delimiter.

workflows.name: Add data validation rules
workflows.text: Define DataValidation rules for dropdown lists or numeric ranges and attach them to a worksheet with AddDataValidation.
